title: Perfect complexes over a commutative ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. An object $C\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is perfect if it is isomorphic in $D(R)$ to a bounded cochain complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules.

lean.note: The recorded upstream IsPerfect requires the localization universe to equal the module universe. HasDerivedCategory.standard on ModuleCat uses the larger object universe, so that interface cannot express the degree-zero quotients here. This module states the identical bounded finite projective model predicate with an independent localization universe.
